event.text: Call 911 now. A fever with purple spots that don't fade when pressed, plus unusual sleepiness, can mean a rapidly worsening bloodstream infection needing hospital treatment immediately. Do not wait for a message reply or for the rash to spread. While waiting, keep him lying down, stay with him, and tell the dispatcher if he becomes hard to wake, has a seizure, or his breathing changes.
